about.title: How it works: Bringing World Art to American Stages
about.desc: Incorporated in 2020, Anizav World Art LLC exists to create opportunities for master Berber and Mediterranean musicians and educators. By pairing authentic acoustic preservation with world-class production management, we offer North American audiences unprecedented access to living legends of poetry, mandole mastery, and timeless rhythms.
about.s1Desc: Anizav World Art LLC is made possible through dedicated collaboration with diaspora communities, musicologists, and patrons who believe in the power of ancestral acoustic art to inspire, transform, and unite. We preserve and present the living repertoire of Kabylia, the Saharan desert, and the wider Mediterranean basin with uncompromised fidelity, while ensuring artists receive direct, transparent, and equitable compensation.
about.s1Link: Learn more about our curatorial vision →
about.s2Desc: We record and share authentic music traditions with a wider international audience through high-definition multi-track audio and multi-camera broadcasts. It’s an accessible way for master artists to extend their cultural reach beyond concert halls while introducing generations of new listeners to ancient Amazigh poetry and mandole stylings.
about.s3Desc: Anizav offers workshops designed around the needs of universities, music conservatories, and community educators. Programs are customized to fit your curriculum, student cohort, and ethnomusicology goals. Just tell us what you're working on and we’ll match you with master artists.
about.card1Desc: Live sessions with master instrumentalists (mandole, oud, bendir), flexible scheduling for universities, music conservatories, and cultural centers.
about.card2Desc: Direct hands-on cultural masterclass with touring artists for students and musicians, with deeper immersion and real-time interaction.
about.s3Link: Learn more about Anizav programs for educators & institutions →
about.s4Title: Artist Care & US P-1 Regulatory Compliance
about.s4Desc: Anizav World Art LLC is a registered cultural event production entity with extensive experience across US immigration classifications (P-1, P-3 visas), venue contracting, state performance licenses, and ASCAP/BMI compliance. We strive to provide transparent contracts, dedicated hospitality riders, and respectful artistic stewardship so musicians focus entirely on their craft.
about.s4CardDesc: Managing transatlantic artist residencies, multi-city theater logistics, and acoustic sound engineering across major US symphonic halls.
about.s4Link: Explore our compliance and tour management charter →
about.s5Desc: Whether you're a theater presenter interested in booking an artist, a cultural institution exploring collaboration, or a patron seeking tickets, we're here to help.
